fato_historico: 1980: A bomb explodes at the railway station in Bologna, Italy, killing 85 people and wounding more than 200.
energia_do_dia: Today, the cosmos invites you to find beauty amidst shadows. Just as history reminds us that even when darkness strikes in distant stations, the human spirit persistently seeks light, you may feel empowered to mend fragmented dreams. It is a good time to pursue joy and transform heavy memories into resilient seeds of hope for your future.
frase_do_dia: Even the softest light can guide you safely through the deepest night.
significado_numero: A powerful symbol of transformation and inner spiritual awakening.
conselho: Consider sharing your optimism with someone who needs a warm, steady heart today.
